sentences.en: This is 99% Invisible.
sentences.zh: 这里是《99%隐形》。

sentences.en: I'm Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我是罗曼·马尔斯。

sentences.en: My name's Melissa Lee, and originally I'm from Hastings-on-Hudson, New York.
sentences.zh: 我叫梅丽莎·李，我来自纽约州黑斯廷斯哈德逊。

sentences.en: It's a small town, I suppose you have to make your own fun.
sentences.zh: 那是个小镇，我想你得自己找乐子。

sentences.en: Everybody makes their own fun.
sentences.zh: 每个人都得自己找乐子。

sentences.en: If you don't make it yourself, it ain't fun, it's entertainment.
sentences.zh: 如果你不自己找，那就不叫乐子，那叫娱乐。

sentences.en: I guess the big activity would be walking downtown after school,
sentences.zh: 我想主要的活动就是放学后在市中心散步，

sentences.en: and you could hang out by the wall and watch people that you knew go by.
sentences.zh: 你可以靠在墙边，看着认识的人走过。

sentences.en: So not a lot going on in Hastings-on-Hudson, New York.
sentences.zh: 所以纽约州黑斯廷斯哈德逊没什么大事发生。

sentences.en: It's about two square miles, but it's right outside New York City,
sentences.zh: 它大约只有两平方英里，但就在纽约市郊外，

sentences.en: so it's sort of like you know there's a lot out there to do,
sentences.zh: 所以你多少知道外面有很多事可以做，

sentences.en: but there's not actually a lot to do right where I was.
sentences.zh: 但实际上我所在的地方并没有什么可做的。

sentences.en: Besides people watching, Melissa and her friends would also collect geodes.
sentences.zh: 除了看人，梅丽莎和她的朋友们还会收集晶洞。

sentences.en: We did collect geodes, yes.
sentences.zh: 我们确实收集过晶洞，是的。

sentences.en: You know about geodes, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道晶洞吧？

sentences.en: Break your own geodes.
sentences.zh: 敲开你自己的晶洞。

sentences.en: The rocks are brown and lumpy on the outside, but when you smash them apart...
sentences.zh: 这些石头外面看起来又棕又粗糙，但当你把它们砸开时……

sentences.en: Inside would be some crystalline structures.
sentences.zh: 里面会有一些晶体结构。

sentences.en: And you have no idea from the outside what you're getting,
sentences.zh: 而且你从外面根本不知道里面会是什么，

sentences.en: so you kind of have to take a chance on it, that inside you've got something great.
sentences.zh: 所以你得碰碰运气，看看里面是不是藏着什么好东西。

sentences.en: Usually Melissa and her friend Liz would buy a few geodes at the store downtown
sentences.zh: 通常梅丽莎和她的朋友莉兹会从市中心的商店买几个晶洞，

sentences.en: and take them home and smash them apart with a hammer.
sentences.zh: 带回家用锤子砸开。

sentences.en: But one day, when Melissa was 13...
sentences.zh: 但有一天，当梅丽莎13岁时……

sentences.en: We were too impatient.
sentences.zh: 我们太没耐心了。

sentences.en: We just had to know what was inside.
sentences.zh: 我们非得知道里面有什么不可。

sentences.en: There was a parking lot nearby with an apartment building,
sentences.zh: 附近有个带公寓楼的停车场，

sentences.en: and we decided to just throw it against the side of the wall as hard as we could
sentences.zh: 我们决定把它往墙上用力扔，

sentences.en: and hope that it would crack open that way.
sentences.zh: 希望能借此把它砸开。

sentences.en: And I think that was the first time that we had tried to open them that way without a hammer,
sentences.zh: 我想那是我们第一次尝试不用锤子，

sentences.en: just by throwing it.
sentences.zh: 仅仅通过投掷来打开它们。

sentences.en: So I threw mine a few times, and finally it did crack open against the wall.
sentences.zh: 我扔了几次，最后它确实在墙上砸开了。

sentences.en: And Liz kept throwing hers, and it wouldn't crack open.
sentences.zh: 而莉兹一直在扔她的那个，却怎么也砸不开。

sentences.en: There was only one little window in this whole back of this apartment building.
sentences.zh: 公寓楼的这一整面墙上只有一个小窗户。

sentences.en: My friend Liz kept throwing hers, and...
sentences.zh: 我的朋友莉兹一直在扔她的那个，然后……

sentences.en: Just a big expanse of brick.
sentences.zh: 只是一大片砖墙。

sentences.en: And Liz kept throwing hers, and it wouldn't crack open.
sentences.zh: 莉兹一直在扔她的那个，但就是砸不开。

sentences.en: So I threw mine, and we saw it going towards the window, and then...
sentences.zh: 于是我扔了我的，我们看着它飞向窗户，然后……

sentences.en: I mean, it felt like it was slow motion.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，感觉就像慢动作一样。

sentences.en: Her aim just went wild, and...
sentences.zh: 她的准头完全偏了，然后……

sentences.en: We were kind of like, no!
sentences.zh: 我们当时就像是，不！

sentences.en: Then the geode went right through the window.
sentences.zh: 然后那个晶洞直接穿过了窗户。

sentences.en: Breaking the glass and shattering it everywhere.
sentences.zh: 玻璃碎了，到处都是。

sentences.en: We heard this huge crashing sound.
sentences.zh: 我们听到了巨大的破碎声。

sentences.en: Glass had broken and was now lying all over the parking lot floor.
sentences.zh: 玻璃碎了，现在散落在停车场的地上。

sentences.en: And the geode was inside.
sentences.zh: 而晶洞在里面。

sentences.en: My first reaction was just pure, full-on fear.
sentences.zh: 我的第一反应就是纯粹的、彻底的恐惧。

sentences.en: I hated doing things wrong.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌做错事。

sentences.en: I hated getting in trouble.
sentences.zh: 我讨厌惹麻烦。

sentences.en: And I just got that terrible, sinking feeling in my stomach.
sentences.zh: 我胃里顿时涌起那种可怕的下沉感。

sentences.en: And I just wanted to get out of there.
sentences.zh: 我只想离开那里。

sentences.en: We were such good kids.
sentences.zh: 我们曾经是那么乖的孩子。

sentences.en: I mean, this is what we did for fun.
sentences.zh: 我是说，这就是我们找乐子的方式。

sentences.en: We broke open geodes.
sentences.zh: 我们敲开晶洞。

sentences.en: We never did anything wrong.
sentences.zh: 我们从没做过坏事。

sentences.en: And now we had committed this heinous act.
sentences.zh: 而现在我们犯下了这桩滔天大罪。

sentences.en: And it was sort of like a quintessential wrong thing that kids can do.
sentences.zh: 这简直是孩子们能做的最典型的坏事。

sentences.en: I mean, you always...
sentences.zh: 我是说，你总是……

sentences.en: I always saw, you know, TV shows or read comic books where kids would break a window.
sentences.zh: 我总是在电视节目或漫画书里看到孩子们打破窗户。

sentences.en: And then they were faced with a dilemma.
sentences.zh: 然后他们面临一个两难境地。

sentences.en: Do they go back and tell the guy that they did it or not?
sentences.zh: 他们是回去告诉那个人是他们干的，还是不告诉？

sentences.en: Hey, let's get out of here!
sentences.zh: 嘿，快离开这儿！

sentences.en: We froze for about 10 seconds.
sentences.zh: 我们僵住了大约10秒钟。

sentences.en: And then my friend Liz ran forward.
sentences.zh: 然后我的朋友莉兹跑了过去。

sentences.en: She reached into the broken glass and grabbed the geode, and we both ran.
sentences.zh: 她伸手进碎玻璃里抓起晶洞，我们俩都跑了。

sentences.en: After initially running, some sort of moral compass started up, and we realized that we
sentences.zh: 跑了一阵后，某种道德指南针开始起作用，我们意识到我们

sentences.en: had to go back, and we had to find this person and tell them what we did.
sentences.zh: 必须回去，必须找到那个人并告诉他们我们做了什么。

sentences.en: Melissa and Liz went back to the apartment building.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎和莉兹回到了公寓楼。

sentences.en: And we tried to figure out where the window led to.
sentences.zh: 我们试图弄清楚那个窗户通向哪里。

sentences.en: But when we ran around to the front, it was very confusing which door might lead to that
sentences.zh: 但当我们跑到前面时，很难分清哪扇门可能通向那个

sentences.en: window.
sentences.zh: 窗户。

sentences.en: And so we knocked on a few doors.
sentences.zh: 于是我们敲了几扇门。

sentences.en: Everyone whose door we knocked on said that it wasn't their window.
sentences.zh: 我们敲过门的每个人都说那不是他们的窗户。

sentences.en: You know, we probably did that for 10 minutes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们可能那样做了10分钟。

sentences.en: And then I think we were like, well, I think we did all that we can do.
sentences.zh: 然后我想我们当时想的是，好吧，我想我们已经尽力了。

sentences.en: And we were probably really glad that we tried, but we weren't able to find out whose window
sentences.zh: 我们可能真的很庆幸自己尝试过，但最终还是没能找到那是谁的窗户。

sentences.en: it was in the end.
sentences.zh: 依然感到内疚的梅丽莎避开了市中心和那扇窗户好几个月，这

sentences.en: Still feeling guilty, Melissa avoided downtown and the window for a couple of months, which
sentences.zh: 在一个小镇里并不容易。

sentences.en: wasn't easy in a small town.
sentences.zh: 我以为我们只要继续过日子，就会有人修好窗户，我

sentences.en: I thought that we would just go about our business, and somebody would fix the window, and I would
sentences.zh: 就再也不用去想它了。

sentences.en: never have to think about it again.
sentences.zh: 但当梅丽莎最终回到那扇窗户时，它依然是破的。

sentences.en: But when Melissa finally did go back to the window, it was still broken.
sentences.zh: 就像卡通片里一样，你知道，一个锯齿状的洞就在那里。

sentences.en: Like a cartoon, just like a, you know, jagged edge hole that was sitting there.
sentences.zh: 甚至掉在停车场里的玻璃碎片都还在那里。

sentences.en: Even the glass shards that had fallen into the parking lot were still lying there.
sentences.zh: 它几乎保持着原样。

sentences.en: It was pretty much like in pristine condition.
sentences.zh: 从我们打破它的那天起，几个月甚至更久之后，它几乎完全

sentences.en: From the day that we had broken it until months and months later, it stayed almost exactly
sentences.zh: 没有变化。

sentences.en: the same.
sentences.zh: 很明显那间公寓是有人住的。

sentences.en: It was clear that the apartment was occupied.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我们有时能看到里面开着电视，所以我们知道确实有人住在那儿。

sentences.en: Actually, we could see a TV on inside sometimes, so we knew somebody did live there.
sentences.zh: 有时窗户会被推上去或拉下来。

sentences.en: And sometimes the window would be raised up or lowered down.
sentences.zh: 所以有人在开关这扇窗户，但那个洞一直都在。

sentences.en: So someone was moving this window around, but the hole was always still in it.
sentences.zh: 我们简直无法想象这个人是谁，竟然什么都不做来修这扇

sentences.en: We just could not even imagine who this person was that wasn't doing anything to fix this
sentences.zh: 窗户。

sentences.en: window.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至连胶带都没贴。

sentences.en: They weren't even putting tape over it.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至在冬天经过时，看到那个洞依然在那里。

sentences.en: And we'd even go by in the winter and see that the hole was still there.
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎读完初中、高中，那扇窗户一直破着。

sentences.en: The window stayed broken as Melissa finished middle school, then finished high school.
sentences.zh: 它并没有像我希望的那样消失。

sentences.en: It just hadn't gone away like I wanted it to.
sentences.zh: 然后我去上了大学。

sentences.en: Then went away to college.
sentences.zh: 我很震惊地发现，即使我离开了小镇，它依然是破的。

sentences.en: And I was shocked to find that it was still broken, even after I'd left town.
sentences.zh: 这成了梅丽莎的一种模式。

sentences.en: And this became the pattern for Melissa.
sentences.zh: 她会离开，去成长。

sentences.en: She'd go away, do some growing up.
sentences.zh: 但当她回家时，看到那扇窗户，感觉就像回到了13岁时

sentences.en: But when she came home, she'd see that window and feel exactly like the 13-year-old kid she
sentences.zh: 打破窗户的那一刻。

sentences.en: was when she broke the window.
sentences.zh: 当我想到13岁时，那是我最尴尬、最糟糕的年纪。

sentences.en: When I think about 13, that's like my most awkward, horrible age.
sentences.zh: 看到这扇窗户就会让我瞬间回到那种初中生的感觉。

sentences.en: The sight of this window would just bring me right back to feeling like a middle schooler
sentences.zh: 梅丽莎现在36岁了。

sentences.en: again.
sentences.zh: 想想你从13岁到36岁之间经历的所有里程碑。

sentences.en: Melissa is 36 now.
sentences.zh: 我离家去上了四年大学。

sentences.en: Think of all the milestones you pass between 13 and 36.
sentences.zh: 到最后，我觉得自己已经很成熟了。

sentences.en: I went away to college for four years.
sentences.zh: 回家，看到窗户，感觉又像个13岁的孩子。

sentences.en: And by the end of that, I felt pretty grown up.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我环游世界了九个月。

sentences.en: Came home, saw the window, felt like a 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 回家，看到窗户，感觉又像个13岁的孩子。

sentences.en: And then after that, I traveled the world for nine months.
sentences.zh: 我去读了研究生。

sentences.en: Came home, saw the window, felt like a 13-year-old.
sentences.zh: 回家。

sentences.en: I went to graduate school.
sentences.zh: 我搬到了华盛顿特区。

sentences.en: Came home.
sentences.zh: 看到了窗户。

sentences.en: I moved to Washington, D.C.
sentences.zh: 我结婚了。

sentences.en: Saw the window.
sentences.zh: 你懂我的意思。

sentences.en: I got married.
sentences.zh: 无论我如何改变，我过去的这一部分却完全冻结了。

sentences.en: You get the idea.
sentences.zh: 一看到那扇窗户，我就立刻被带回了我们打破它时的初中时代。

sentences.en: As much as I was changing, this part of my past was completely frozen.
sentences.zh: 所以在2011年……

sentences.en: As soon as I saw the window, I was just brought right back to those middle school days when
sentences.zh: 当我大约35岁时……

sentences.en: we had broken it.
sentences.zh: 在她和朋友打破窗户22年后……
我决定一劳永逸地找出那是谁的窗户并道歉。

sentences.en: When I'm about 35 years old...
sentences.zh: 我想，你知道，也提出赔偿。

sentences.en: 22 years after she and her friend broke the window...
sentences.zh: 现在我这次是真的在录音了。

sentences.en: I decide to find out once and for all whose window it is and apologize.
sentences.zh: 我不想对你刻薄。

sentences.en: And I guess, you know, offer to pay for it as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，我带着我姐姐去市中心给我壮胆。

sentences.en: Now I'm recording this time for real.
sentences.zh: 窗户上的洞还在那里。

sentences.en: I don't want to be mean to you.
sentences.zh: 我的心跳得好快。

sentences.en: So, um, I go downtown with my sister accompanying me for courage.
sentences.zh: 我是不是该直接说，对不起，我不是故意要打扰你的。

sentences.en: The hole is still there in the window.
sentences.zh: 我只是，我相信，我知道是谁打破了那扇窗户。

sentences.en: And my heart is beating so faSt.
sentences.zh: 他就在那儿。

sentences.en: Should I just say, I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I just, I believe that, like, I know who broke that window.
sentences.zh: 我非常非常紧张地脱口而出……

sentences.en: He's right there.
sentences.zh: 对不起，对不起，我不是想打扰你。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 我只是想来弥补一下，嗯，我想多年前，我不确定，

sentences.en: And I very, very nervously blurt out...
sentences.zh: 但我认为我和我的朋友打破了那扇窗户。

sentences.en: I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm not trying to bother you.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想来弥补一下。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to actually make amends for, um, I think that years ago, I'm not sure,
sentences.zh: 你打破的？

sentences.en: but I think my friend and I broke that window.
sentences.zh: 我想是的。

sentences.en: And so I kind of just wanted to make amends for it.
sentences.zh: 你现在才来告诉我？

sentences.en: You broke it?
sentences.zh: 嗯，其实当时我试着找过你，但没找到。

sentences.en: I think so.
sentences.zh: 然后20年后，我回到了家乡。

sentences.en: And you're telling me now?
sentences.zh: 我离开了，你知道，从那以后我就没回来过。

sentences.en: Well, I actually tried to find you at the time and I couldn't find you.
sentences.zh: 基本上就是这样。

sentences.en: And then 20 years later, I came back to my hometown.
sentences.zh: 所以我只是想弄清楚，你知道，那是谁的。

sentences.en: I left, you know, I haven't been back since then.
sentences.zh: 你最近怎么样？

sentences.en: And basically that's what happened.
sentences.zh: 很好。

sentences.en: So I just wanted to kind of find out, you know, whose it was.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: How are you doing?
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Good.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: She's been looking for me 20 years.
sentences.zh: 她找了我20年。

sentences.en: She just said she found me.
sentences.zh: 她刚才说她找到我了。

sentences.en: You believe it?
sentences.zh: 你相信吗？

sentences.en: For 20 years.
sentences.zh: 整整20年。

sentences.en: Well, I left town for a while.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我离开那个镇子有一阵子了。

sentences.en: But he didn't want to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 但他不想跟我说话。

sentences.en: He thought it was amusing that I was now fessing up.
sentences.zh: 他觉得我现在才坦白这件事很有趣。

sentences.en: And when I offered to pay for it, he said...
sentences.zh: 当我提出要赔偿时，他说……

sentences.en: No, don't worry.
sentences.zh: 不，别担心。

sentences.en: No?
sentences.zh: 不？

sentences.en: I'm surprised.
sentences.zh: 我很惊讶。

sentences.en: It's been like that's so long.
sentences.zh: 这种情况持续太久了。

sentences.en: I know.
sentences.zh: 我知道。

sentences.en: Well, why did you just decide to leave it like that?
sentences.zh: 那你为什么决定就那样放着不管呢？

sentences.en: Get a nice breeze in the back there?
sentences.zh: 后面那儿有凉风吹进来吗？

sentences.en: The landlord was supposed to fix it.
sentences.zh: 房东本该修好它的。

sentences.en: The landlord had never fixed it?
sentences.zh: 房东从来没修过吗？

sentences.en: He never did.
sentences.zh: 他从来没修过。

sentences.en: Well, he was looking for the person that did it.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他一直在找弄坏窗户的人。

sentences.en: And when I offered to pay for it, he said no, that he'd gotten used to it.
sentences.zh: 当我提出要赔偿时，他说不用，他已经习惯了。

sentences.en: He'd just left it.
sentences.zh: 他就那样放着没管。

sentences.en: I grew into that broken window and did it.
sentences.zh: 我适应了那扇破窗户，就那样过来了。

sentences.en: In fact, I love it.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我很喜欢它。

sentences.en: I wouldn't get it fixed for nothing.
sentences.zh: 给我多少钱我都不修。

sentences.en: Anyway, I'm sorry, but I'm glad that you've come to like the broken window.
sentences.zh: 总之，我很抱歉，但我很高兴你已经开始喜欢那扇破窗户了。

sentences.en: My name is Melissa, by the way.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一下，我叫梅丽莎。

sentences.en: Good luck.
sentences.zh: 祝你好运。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你。

sentences.en: It was nice to meet you after all these years.
sentences.zh: 时隔多年能见到你真好。

sentences.en: I've wondered about it.
sentences.zh: 我一直对此感到好奇。

sentences.en: That's kind of an understatement.
sentences.zh: 那话说得有点轻描淡写了。

sentences.en: Whatever it was that was keeping me, you know, stuck in middle school there,
sentences.zh: 无论是什么让我，你知道，困在中学时代的那件事，

sentences.en: was sort of keeping him stuck with this broken window.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上也让他困在了这扇破窗户里。

sentences.en: And he just was content to live with it.
sentences.zh: 而他竟然就那样安于现状。

sentences.en: The broken windows theory proposed in 1982 says that a seemingly small act of vandalism,
sentences.zh: 1982年提出的“破窗理论”认为，看似微小的破坏行为，

sentences.en: if it goes unfixed, can precipitate further vandalism and even more serious crime.
sentences.zh: 如果得不到修复，可能会引发进一步的破坏，甚至更严重的犯罪。

sentences.en: That really didn't happen here, except for Melissa's life on the lam for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 这里并没有发生这种情况，除了梅丽莎逃亡了20年。

sentences.en: But the broken window did weigh on Melissa.
sentences.zh: 但那扇破窗户确实成了梅丽莎的心病。

sentences.en: And I'm guessing it affected the man in the apartment more than he's letting on.
sentences.zh: 我猜它对那间公寓男主人的影响比他表现出来的要大。

sentences.en: And a random passerby, less so.
sentences.zh: 而对于偶然路过的人来说，影响则小得多。

sentences.en: And Hastings on Hudson, New York, soldiered on without missing a beat.
sentences.zh: 而纽约州黑斯廷斯市依然如故，生活节奏丝毫不受影响。

sentences.en: Architecture is personal.
sentences.zh: 建筑是私人的。

sentences.en: The strangest part of our interaction with the built environment
sentences.zh: 我们与建筑环境互动中最奇怪的部分在于，

sentences.en: is what can be so evocative and meaningful for you
sentences.zh: 那些对你而言极具感染力和意义的事物，

sentences.en: can mean absolutely nothing to someone else.
sentences.zh: 对别人来说可能毫无意义。

sentences.en: This time when I was in town, I just didn't really even...
sentences.zh: 这次我回到镇上时，我甚至没怎么……

sentences.en: I think I was even in town for a few days before I even thought about the window.
sentences.zh: 我想我在镇上待了几天，甚至都没想起那扇窗户。

sentences.en: I didn't really even wonder about it very much.
sentences.zh: 我其实并没有太在意它。

sentences.en: And then in the end, I didn't even go down and look.
sentences.zh: 最后，我甚至没去那儿看一眼。

sentences.en: 99% Invisible is Sam Greenspan and me, Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 《99% Invisible》由萨姆·格林斯潘和我，罗曼·马斯共同制作。

sentences.en: It's a project of 91.7, local public radio, KALW in San Francisco,
sentences.zh: 这是旧金山KALW地方公共广播电台91.7频道的一个项目，

sentences.en: and the American Institute of Architects in San Francisco.
sentences.zh: 也是旧金山美国建筑师协会的项目。

sentences.en: You can find the show and like the show on Facebook.
sentences.zh: 你可以在Facebook上找到并关注我们的节目。

sentences.en: I tweet at Roman Mars.
sentences.zh: 我的推特账号是Roman Mars。

sentences.en: But this week, you have to see the original art by Emile Holmwood of the Caravan
sentences.zh: 但本周，你一定要看看埃米尔·霍姆伍德（Emile Holmwood）为《Caravan》创作的原创艺术作品，

sentences.en: illustrating this story that you just heard.
sentences.zh: 它为你刚才听到的故事做了插图。

sentences.en: It just makes me so happy.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到非常开心。

sentences.en: Check it out at 99percentinvisible.org.
sentences.zh: 请访问 99percentinvisible.org 查看。

sentences.en: Radiotopia.
sentences.zh: Radiotopia。
